_note: New actor, first pricing entry. Market (2026-10-09): shahidirfan/Dice-Job-Scraper $0.001 per item + $0.005 start (199 monthly users), worldunboxer/dice-jobs-scraper tiered (76), easyapi/dice-com-job-scraper (26). job $0.001 from search data (up to 10,000 per search); job_detail $0.002 with the job page read (full description, skills). No start fee. No proxy: the Dice search API answered Apify IPs 5/5 in the 2026-10-09 probe.

job.eventDescription: One Dice job with title, company, location, salary text and parsed min and max, employment type, workplace, employer type, sponsorship, easy apply, posted and updated dates, summary and URL. A search with no results is free.

job_detail.eventDescription: The same job plus its full description, skills list, ZIP code and expiry date, read from the job page. Only with Full description on; charged instead of Job, not on top of it.
